name: Acceptance suite-2 test 36 - add a user to a privileged group
note: IAM-1005: iam:AddUserToGroup on a group ARN is an INDIRECT privilege assignment. It yields the dedicated GROUP-MEMBERSHIP finding (high), NOT generic DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN / AttachUserPolicy / PutUserPolicy. Group privilege is inferred from the name (PlatformAdmins) at medium confidence only; the added user is a request parameter, not resource-scoped by this ARN.
